properties.title: Social Security Administration: 287 public Bluesky posts report it down or out in 6 h (usual 6.6)
properties.summary: Members of the public posted 287 times on Bluesky naming "Social Security" with "down" (287) or "outage" (0) in the 6 hours to 22:14 UTC 18 Nov 2026, against a usual of 6.6 for that many hours over the 7 days before. Posts were already over the line in the window's first hour (from 16:14 UTC 18 Nov 2026) and peaked in the hour from 18:14 UTC 18 Nov 2026. Reported by the public on Bluesky and not confirmed by Social Security Administration; Blackout counts the posts and does not read or keep them. Blackout does not assess its cause. A surge can also be news of an outage elsewhere that names the company, a joke, the words in another sense, or the company's own denial (BO-H-7B).

baseline_ref.window: rolling: the same two searches over the 7 days before the 6-hour window, scaled to 6 hours (the usual taken as at least the floor)
